title: Writing Task 2 - Crime Prevention
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: What are the causes of crime and what measures can governments and individuals take?

stimuli.title: Task 2: Causes and Prevention of Crime
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

Crime rates in many cities around the world are rising. What are the main causes of this trend, and what measures can governments and individuals take to address it?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay identifying causes of rising crime rates and proposing solutions for governments and individuals.

questions.content: What are the main causes of rising crime rates, and what measures can governments and individuals take?

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: Identify multiple causes and propose corresponding measures; cover both government and individual levels
bandDescriptors.coherence: Use cause-and-effect and problem-solution discourse patterns with clear signposting
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use crime-related vocabulary: recidivism, deterrence, rehabilitation, poverty cycle, law enforcement
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Use a mix of complex sentence types including causal, conditional, and purpose clauses

sampleIdeas: Poverty and unemployment are key drivers as people turn to crime for economic survival
Weak law enforcement and lenient sentencing may fail to deter potential offenders
Governments can invest in education, youth programmes, and community policing
Individuals can improve neighbourhood watch schemes and report suspicious activity
